text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! How could I run so ungracefully?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was in no way an exemplary
performance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was the footwork of a failing
student! I'm
going full-Bakushin down
the road to becoming a
delinquent!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain how getting back up again
after being
knocked down is the key to
success.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, I'm actually going
full-Bakushin
on the glorious road of a
model student?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! I can't back down like this! I have
to get
back to training right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I have to set an example for everyone,
so I can't
stand still for even a moment!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...That's right.
It's not as if I've retired
from being
class representative!
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to be a role mode...
Aren't you going to be a role mode...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's my duty to throw my heart and soul
into
leading the others until the very
end!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A model student from the cradle to the
grave!
That is me, Sakura Bakushin O!
